notes.title: Early Access - Week 37
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35031815/c74c88ce78a11bb22781518d7daa67cb21bfbace.png[/img]

Hello!

For week 37, we have a few small additions and fixes:

Additions:
- New Skin - Evo: A black, white and red skin based on the livery of a famous record breaking race car.

Fixes:
- Photo Mode's rotation and translation speed are dependent on the current field of view - should make it easier and more comfortable to work with very small FOVs.

notes.title: Early Access - Week 36
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35031815/94e3278e67d1b06e97a521c6db5e026e35e44460.png[/img]

Hello!

For week 36, we have a few small additions and fixes:

Additions:
- New Skin - Original: This simple skin is a recreation of the very first skin used during development of the game, before any real texture had been made.

Fixes:
- Fixed glitch that prevented the correct texture to be loaded onto the plane's engines for certain skins.
- Photo Mode now automatically hides the interface when taking pictures.

notes.title: Early Access - Week 35
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35031815/e5f665b01057506b61ffd33dfae39f5042619b24.png[/img]

Hello!

We are finally back with more updates! For week 35 of Early Access, we have a new feature:

- Photo Mode: Pause the game at any time during gameplay or replays and open Photo Mode! It allows you to freely move the camera, adjust the field of view and save pictures from the game to your computer as .png files.

Please note that Photo Mode utilizes its own controls. Due to the way the game saves your control settings, all the Photo Mode controls will be unassigned if you have played the game before and saved your control settings. Please assign them on your own or simply use the button "Restore Defaults" on the Controls Settings screen.

notes.title: Early Access - Week 29
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35031815/be81773a3a6e77c06b107c3d293d1f31b97ecd7b.png[/img]

Hello!

For week 29 of Early Access, we have a few changes:

Changes

- Rebalanced medal times for Hard and Ace tracks to be more in line with Easy and Medium tracks.
- New instructional replay for Ace track "Free Falling" to reflect new strategy for getting Gold Medal.

notes.title: Early Access - Week 20
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35031815/4d16ba5b7696c4a71f941be38c7cc1f3292a643f.png[/img]

Hello!

For week 20 of Early Access, we have a few misc additions and fixes:

Additions
- Added 4k resolution textures for the planes.
- Added normal mapping to the planes.
- Made available option to toggle between vertical and horizontal splitscreen for multiplayer. Thanks to Voltaic Backlash for suggesting this.

Fixes/Changes
- Fixed glitch that caused Leaderboard buttons to stop working.
- Fixed looping of the song in Medium tracks. Thanks to Voltaic Backlash for reporting this.
- Rebalanced Gold Medal times for tracks up to the Hard Tutorials according to leaderboard data due to feedback that they were too frustrating.

notes.title: Early Access - Week 19
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35031815/fb16fde6f7f749f645f86c42e39910ed5dc635cf.png[/img]

Hello!

For week 19 of Early Access, we have a few misc additions and fixes:

- Allow player to assign the same button/axis to different actions in the control settings. This was necessary to allow assigning the same input for throttle/brake on Combined and Separate mode (if wanted). Thanks to Voltaic Backlash for reporting this.

- Added preliminary tracking camera. Tracks the next checkpoint in a race or the enemy plane in Combat multiplayer mode. Thanks to FasterThanRaito for suggesting it.
